title: Beyond the ML Model: Applying Safety Engineering Frameworks to Text-to-Image Development
findings: The paper demonstrates that safety engineering frameworks like FMEA and STPA can effectively uncover a wide range of functional, social, and ethical failures and hazards in text-to-image model development pipelines. This can be done by analyzing processes and interactions (e.g., data processing, product integration) without needing deep technical details of the model itself. However, the analysis did not include any specific examination of risks, biases, or stereotypes related to religion or faith.
